copy.tagline: 管理 Firebase 存储中的文件上传与下载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 Firebase Storage 进行文件操作
copy.tagline_en: Manage file uploads and downloads in Firebase Storage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with Firebase Storage for file operations

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能够指导你完成 Firebase Storage 的配置、文件上传/下载、元数据管理、错误处理以及安全规则设置等操作。
howto.when: 当需要设置 Cloud Storage、上传/下载文件或管理元数据时，或询问错误处理与安全规则时触发。

say.text: 如何在 Flutter 中上传文件到 Firebase Storage？
say.note: Claude 会提供上传代码示例和进度监控。

say.text: 帮我获取文件的下载链接。
say.note: Claude 会展示获取下载 URL 的方法。

say.text: 设置 Storage 的安全规则。
say.note: Claude 会解释规则要点并给出示例。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to guide you through Firebase Storage setup, file uploads/downloads, metadata management, error handling, and security rules in Flutter.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up Cloud Storage, uploading/downloading files, or managing metadata; also for error handling or security rules.

say_en.text: How to upload a file to Firebase Storage in Flutter?
say_en.note: Claude will provide code with progress monitoring.

say_en.text: Get the download URL for a file.
say_en.note: Claude shows how to retrieve the download link.

say_en.text: Set up security rules for Storage.
say_en.note: Claude explains rules and gives an example.
